explicit_decision.scheduling_change: Allow the first retained memory-lock acquisition to wait only within the original request_started_ns+500ms budget captured once. This replaces immediate local WouldBlock refusal and is a real bounded latency/CPU tradeoff.
explicit_decision.mirror: Release-published only after full accepted Retained data while holding the same mutex; it limits admission and grants no authority.
explicit_decision.clock: Production current and accept take validation BOOTTIME under the actual retained mutex. All original age/clock/identity/revocation checks remain.
explicit_decision.barrier: Checked generation prevents full begin/end ABA and overflow; no old or permanent fence is cleared.
explicit_decision.session: After bounded cache reading, real BOOTTIME is checked against the exact same end_boottime_ns; expiry or clock error fences before returning authority.
explicit_decision.error_scope: A read whose old admission expired can fail while a newer valid shared feed survives. Already returned Authority errors and consumed/fenced purpose clients are not retried or revived.
explicit_decision.scope_of_no_owner_IO: Normal production code holds no filesystem/network/durable-owner callback in this cache critical section. Existing cfg(test) error stderr may execute while the lock is held.
